ranges.name: narrow
ranges.note: ultra-tight; expect to spend most of 15m near the boundary

ranges.name: wide
ranges.note: lazy; ~5% width — minimal IL but minimal fee capture too

reasoning: Narrow (±20 ticks ≈ ±0.20%) gives the highest fee_capture density but a 15m hold at 0.01% USDT/WBNB has high probability of exiting the range (the pair moves >0.20% intraday routinely). Exit-out-of-range means 0 fees + full IL — defeats the purpose of the probe.
Wide (±500 ticks ≈ ±5%) is safe but earns negligible fees in 15m. The probe is supposed to MEASURE actual fee accrual; near-zero fees give us no signal.

Medium (±100 ticks ≈ ±1%) is the goldilocks: very likely to stay in-range for 15m on a 0.01% major-pair pool, and concentrated enough that we'll observe non-zero feeGrowthInside delta to calibrate the EV model.
recommendation.if_human_overrides_with_narrow: Acceptable IF the operator wants to stress-test the exit logic (S3 tick_out_of_range stop). Document the choice in approval phrase.
recommendation.if_human_overrides_with_wide: Discouraged for probe; the fee-accrual signal will be too weak to calibrate sizing. Useful only if operator wants to test the pure 'channel' validation without fee-accrual measurement.
